description_en: Directly transfer a call to another agent, a skill group queue, or an external number. Direct transfer is also known as blind transfer or single-step transfer
description_zh: 直接转接通话到其他坐席或某个技能组队列或外部号码，直接转接也叫盲转或单步转
kebab_example: aliyun ccc blind-transfer --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id ACC-YUNBS-1.0.10-0000 --transferor 083143250000 --transferee agent@ccc-test --timeout-seconds 60 --job-id job-65382141036850000 --call-priority 5 --strategy-name 'MOST_IDLE，MOST_SKILLED，MOST_ACQUAINTED，CUSTOMIZED等' --strategy-params '当分配策略为CUSTOMIZED时，本参数的内容为如下格式：_functionId_:_512fed64-e379-400f-a1a5-14d5730xxxxx_,_functionName_:_routing-strategy-test-2' --transferee-type SKILL_GROUP --contact-flow-variables '{"name":"王先生","time":"19点20分","address":"某某中心"}' --routing-type Manual --tags '5295578135#WAEtqY5U_Biz_Package_Rexian_Zhuanjieanquanyungaojie_2527' --queuing-timeout-seconds 10 --queuing-overflow-threshold 0 --skill-group-id ee914df4-82bf-4919-bcb3-9cb8aa437f35 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BlindTransfer

parameters.help_en: The agent ID that initiates a direct transfer
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: The transfer initiator. When the scenario involves directly transferring to an external number, the number specified by this parameter is used as the caller. This parameter is invalid when transferring to an internal agent or skill group; in such cases, the initiator is specified by the UserId parameter
parameters.help_zh: 转接发起方，当场景是直接转接到外部号码时，用此参数指定的号码作为主叫，转内部坐席或技能组时，此参数无效，发起方由UserId指定
parameters.name: transferor

parameters.help_en: The transfer recipient, which can be either an agent ID or a skill group ID
parameters.help_zh: 被转接方，可以是坐席ID或技能组ID
parameters.name: transferee

parameters.help_en: Timeout duration for the direct transfer, in seconds. If the transferee does not answer within the specified time, the call is disconnected. This field is optional and defaults to 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh: 直接转接超时时间，超过指定时间被转接方没有接起通话，则挂断通话，此字段选填，默认30，单位秒
parameters.name: timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The queue priority when transferring to a skill group. Valid values are 0–9, where 0 is the highest priority and 9 is the lowest
parameters.help_zh: 转接到技能组队列时的排队优先级，取值范围0-9，0优先级最高，9最低
parameters.name: call_priority

parameters.help_en: The policy name for agent assignment when transferring to a skill group queue
parameters.help_zh: 转接到技能组队列时的座席分配策略名称
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en: The parameters for the agent assignment policy when transferring to a skill group queue
parameters.help_zh: 转接到技能组队列时的座席分配策略参数
parameters.name: strategy_params

parameters.help_en: Destination type for the transfer. Valid values are AGENT, SKILL_GROUP, IVR, and EXTERNAL_NUMBER. If this parameter is not specified, the system determines the destination type based on the format of the target number. If the automatic detection is inaccurate, you must explicitly specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 转接目的类型，可选值为AGENT，SKILL_GROUP，IVR和EXTERNAL_NUMBER。如果此参数不传，则系统会根据转接的目标号码的格式进行判断，如果发现有判不准确的情况，则需要指定此参数
parameters.name: transferee_type

parameters.help_en: Variables passed to the contact flow. This field is optional. The variables configured here can be retrieved and used in the IVR flow. The format is a JSON string representing a set of key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 传递给联系流的变量，选填，这里配置的变量，可以在IVR流程中拿到并使用，格式为JSON字符串格式的键值对集合
parameters.name: contact_flow_variables

parameters.help_en: The call routing type. Valid values are Automatic or Manual. If this parameter is empty, the system defaults to Automatic routing, which is also the current default behavior of the system. When Manual routing is selected, you must invoke APIs such as ClaimCall to assign the call to a specific agent
parameters.help_zh: 话务分配类型，可选参数为自动分配(Automatic)或者手动分配(Manual)。如果此参数为空，则默认为自动分配的方式，这也是当前系统的默认行为。选择手动分配方式时，需要您自己配合调用ClaimCall等接口把电话分给指定的座席
parameters.name: routing_type

parameters.help_en: Ingest endpoint data, primarily used for extension purposes. Regular users do not need to concern themselves with this field
parameters.help_zh: 随路数据，主要用于扩展需求，普通用户无需关心
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The queuing timeout duration in seconds when the transfer target is a skill group queue
parameters.help_zh: 当转接目标是技能组队列时排队超时时间，单位为秒
parameters.name: queuing_timeout_seconds

parameters.help_en: The queuing overflow threshold when the transfer target is a skill group queue. The default value is 0, which means no overflow occurs
parameters.help_zh: 当转接目标是技能组队列时排队溢出阈值。默认值为0，表示不溢出
parameters.name: queuing_overflow_threshold

CallType.description_en: The call type of the channel

ChannelState.description_en: The status of the voice channel

Destination.description_en: The callee of the voice channel

Originator.description_en: The calling party of the call channel

ReleaseInitiator.description_en: The party that initiated the hang-up of the call channel, indicating who first terminated the call
ReleaseInitiator.description_zh: 话务通道的挂断方，表示该话务通道是谁首先发起的挂断

ReleaseReason.description_en: The reason for releasing the voice channel, indicating why the current voice channel was disconnected. The value is derived from the response codes defined in the SIP protocol. Customers can refer to the SIP protocol to analyze the disconnection reason
ReleaseReason.description_zh: 话务通道的挂断原因，表示当前话务通道为什么会被挂断，取值来自SIP协议中定义的响应码，请客户参考SIP协议分析挂断原因

Timestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp (in milliseconds) of the most recent status change of the channel
Timestamp.description_zh: 话务通道最近一次状态变化的时间戳，格式是Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

UserExtension.description_en: The extension number of the agent associated with the channel
UserExtension.description_zh: 话务通道关联的坐席的分机号

UserId.description_en: The agent ID associated with the call channel. This field is empty for a Customer's call channel
UserId.description_zh: 话务通道关联的坐席ID，如果是客户的话务通道，该字段为空

ContextId.description_en: System auto increment ID. Customers do not need to concern themselves with this
ContextId.description_zh: 系统自增ID，客户无需关心

BreakCode.description_en: Break status code, which can be either System-defined or Custom-defined. System-defined break codes include: Warm-up (temporary break state after agent is published and before becoming idle), RingingTimeout (break caused by agent ringing timeout), and RejectCall (break caused by agent call rejection). There are no restrictions on Custom-defined status codes; customers can define them according to their business needs
BreakCode.description_zh: 小休状态码，分为系统定义的和客户定义的两种，系统定义的小休吗包括：Warm-up （坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态）、RingingTimeout（坐席振铃超时导致的小休）、RejectCall（坐席拒接导致的小休）。客户自定义状态码没有限制，客户可以根据业务需要自行定义

enumValueTitles.RingingTimeout: 坐席振铃超时导致的小休
enumValueTitles.Warm-up: 坐席上线后置闲前的临时小休状态

DeviceId.description_en: Device ID, the identity ID of a browser-based Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) softphone or a physical phone device. Only one type of device can be registered at a time
DeviceId.description_zh: 设备ID，浏览器WebRTC软电话或实体话机设备的标识ID，同一时间只允许一种设备注册

Heartbeat.description_en: The time when the last heartbeat was received from the agent, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
Heartbeat.description_zh: 上次收到坐席心跳的时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

OutboundScenario.description_en: Indicates whether the agent is in outbound-only mode
OutboundScenario.description_zh: 坐席是否处于仅外呼模式

Reserved.description_en: The most recent time when the agent was reserved. Being reserved means an incoming call will soon be assigned to this agent. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
Reserved.description_zh: 坐席最近一次被预定的时间，被预定意味着马上将有来电分配给该坐席，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒

SignedSkillGroupIdList.description_en: List of skill group IDs that the agent has signed into
SignedSkillGroupIdList.description_zh: 坐席签入的技能组ID列表
